description: Adapt all file path handling for Windows: backslash separators, long path support (\\?\), default save location (Videos folder via app.getPath), temp directory for segments (os.tmpdir), and file locking during recording. Use IPC-based native save dialog. Handle OneDrive/cloud-synced folders gracefully (warn about sync conflicts during recording). Ensure segment cleanup works with Windows file locking semantics.
title: Windows file system paths and save dialog
